subject: error message when trying to plot means

messages.author: 3274878f728a4d53
messages.subject: error message when trying to plot means
parts:
Hello,

I'm hoping you can help me out.

Using Mplus Automation, I run all of the following commands with no problem:
mplus.list.variables
mplus.get.data
mplus.get.time_scores
mplus.view.plots
mplus.plot.histogram

It seems to be reading my file correctly and displaying appropriate values, etc.

But when I try to run these commands (which are the ones I really need to function):

mplus.get.estimated_means
mplus.plot.estimated_means
mplus.get.sample_means
mplus.plot.sample_means

I keep getting this error:

Error in gh5$means_and_variances_data$y_estimated_means$values[i, var_indices[j]] : subscript out of bounds

What should I do?

Thanks much.
